assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's single curated item, reviewed-dedicated-analysis: the canonical V2 character reconstruction model MHA_SP2_JIRO_KYOKA_CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MODEL.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the Japanese main manga V01-V42 with the source-labeled Ultra Archive, Ultra Analysis and Ultra Age claims its JK-SUP-01 to JK-SUP-03 sections admit. The MHA character modeling schema was consulted for method only; the readiness index, supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit and the deep readings are not curated evidence on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them. The model's strong label and its retrospective holdout probe are inputs, not conclusions. No original manga page, anime adaptation, V1 material or other character's model is included, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Jiro from the V02:p174-179 role coordination and the V08:p082-086 exam support of Koda, through the V19:p041-042 and p079-087 choice of the festival music project, the V20:p077-096 performance with family support, the V22:p095-111 acoustic-locator team role and the V36:p073-088 final-war response to All For One, to the V42:p169 adult peer and professional scene. Kept as separable states: early sensory teammate, embarrassed hobbyist, chosen musical leader, frightened final-war actor and adult peer/professional; the V36 empathy update is not assigned to earlier states and the repaired ear is not treated as restored. No atom covers V01, V03-V07, V09-V18, V21, V23-V35 or V37-V41.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: The model states a context-sensitive hierarchy (protect friends and fulfill the live task, make a chosen skill useful, keep competence without accepting every personal spotlight), a feared self as inadequate or frivolous where enthusiasm becomes public and an ideal self who reaches people through chosen work, grounded in located atoms JK01-JK05. The model itself labels these inferences, not a complete private insecurity history, and the probe JK-V01 rates motive partial. Not B: one compact artifact, one retrospective nonblind probe, motive partial and adult private breadth OPEN. Not D: the hierarchy is operational, conditioned on consent to the role, audience, relational stakes and threat.

Five named states are separated, with located changes: hobby discounted then chosen as a project she leads (JK02-JK03), fear under lethal asymmetry producing a new understanding of Midoriya's and Aoyama's burden (JK05), and adult peer and professional life (JK06, JK-SUP-02). The model marks the REVISE of hobby/hero incompatibility and the probe treats the V36 empathy update as new state rather than predicted. Not B: long intervals are unsampled and the adult state rests on one page plus supplements. Not D: change is located and the frozen probe keeps the earlier state from absorbing the later one.

The model identifies ウチ as a characteristic self-reference, casual bluntness and teasing with embarrassment markers in peer speech, decisive technical direction in a chosen domain, and direct protective anger in JK05; it warns against a universal coarse dialect or constant sarcasm, and the probe rates speech/register supported. Not C: no located lines are quoted and voice confidence is stated to be strongest only for classmates and music or field contexts. Not E: a recurrent register and its functional variants are identified and tested on one axis. The discovery row does not enroll SPEECH.

Several ordinary windows are located: festival rehearsal and teaching with standards (JK02), the family's support and the performance (JK03) and adult peer life around neighboring offices (JK06); the reciprocal music-taste exchange with Yaoyorozu (JK-SUP-01) and continuing adult music and schedule-dependent guitar or bass instruction for Eri (JK-SUP-02) are profile, editorial, author-comment and bonus-fiction claims. Not C: no recurrent daily routine is modeled and the adult music practice is not enacted manga conduct. Not E: more than one located ordinary-life context exists.

A five-row partner table gives conditional behavior toward her parents, Yaoyorozu and festival peers, Koda and tactical teams, Midoriya and Aoyama, and Kaminari and teasing peers, with a located delta for Midoriya and Aoyama (JK05) and a located boundary against romance-by-proximity (JK06, directly checked); the probe rates relationship handling supported. Not B: most rows are static, parents and adult relations are thinly sampled, and private adult relationships are OPEN. Not D: several partners have located, conditioned behavior.

Located interior states are embarrassment at attention to a hobby (JK02-JK03) and fear that revises her understanding of friends' terror (JK05). The model says the feared and ideal self are inferences from embarrassment, standards and performance, and that the manga does not supply a complete inner record; the probe rates emotional trajectory supported only conditionally and motive partial. Not C: interior regulation is inferred from conduct, not analyzed from her own disclosures. Not E: located emotional windows anchor the inference.

The decision policy is explicit: use domain knowledge to find a useful role, enable the person with the needed capacity, commit once a project is chosen, and resist devaluation of friends even when outclassed; it is not a policy of maximum visibility. Located in JK01, JK04 and JK05, with conditions (role consent, audience, relational stakes, physical threat) that change the response. The probe rates action supported narrowly and leaves the technical payoff unpredicted. Not B: one probe, narrow on action, and private interpersonal conflict is little sampled. Not D: the policy is explicit, located and conditioned.

The model locates a moral stance rather than a deliberation: she centers concrete others over rank and rejects All For One's disposable-extra hierarchy for crying friends (JK05). No choice weighing competing goods is located or analyzed. Not C: there is no located deliberation with named competing considerations. Not E: the stance is located and its basis (concrete others, not her own strength) is stated. The discovery row does not enroll ETHICS.

The model names sarcasm and teasing as a way of regulating ordinary exposure and warns against making every line sarcastic, but locates no humor scene; JK06's collective response is others' romantic inference, which she rejects. Not D: humor is a named register, not an analyzed practice across partners.

The project's analytical corpus is complete for V01-V42 and the admitted supplements; six atoms span V02-V42 with page locators, and JK06 was directly checked. Long intervals are unsampled, JK06's ensuing response is not page-bounded, the adult state is one page, and the supplements are other-character judgment, profile facts, editorial summaries, an author comment and bonus fiction.

Affirmative limits are located: the model REJECTs fearlessness, disposable-extra logic and romance-by-proximity (JK05-JK06); her sound's effect on All For One depends on his unstable factor system and allied follow-through, not raw superiority; her repaired left ear is explicitly not restored (JK-SUP-03); her parents support her chosen path, so rebellion against a forced career must not be invented (JK03); and JK01 and JK04 caution against a solo-star model. Not B: limits rest on few windows in one artifact.

Atoms are page-located with the V31 page convention stated, the frozen probe separates V20 inputs from V36 comparison, JK06 is directly checked, and the supplement records carry EARLIER_ONLY or ENDPOINT chronology. Not B: long intervals are unsampled, JK06's ensuing response is not bounded and in-world dates are not given.

scenario_readiness.note: The model quotes no located lines and states that exact invented dialogue should be labeled simulation, not quotation; register markers are named, voice confidence is limited to classmates and music or field contexts, and romantic interiority is unestablished. Lines beyond the described register would be fluent invention. This bounds the evidence set, not Jiro's actual speech.

conditions: Chronology is one named state, stated explicitly: early sensory teammate, embarrassed hobbyist before V19, chosen musical leader V19-V20, frightened final-war actor at V36, or adult peer/professional at V42; the V36 empathy update and adult music mentoring are not given to earlier states.

The interlocutor is a parent, Yaoyorozu or a festival peer, Koda or a tactical teammate, Midoriya or Aoyama, Kaminari or a teasing peer, or a learner in a chosen music project, handled as the partner table gives; no invented private or romantic relationship.
Earphone Jack is a hearing interface and a vulnerability; damage to it matters, the repaired ear is not restored, and acoustic effects depend on the target and allies rather than raw output.

Output is a behavioral description conditioned on role consent, audience, relational stakes and threat, with alternatives; no quoted dialogue is produced as canon and no readiness is inherited from the strong label.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state: early teammate, hobbyist, chosen musical leader, final-war actor or adult peer/professional, stated explicitly.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Parents, Yaoyorozu and festival peers, Koda and tactical teams, Midoriya and Aoyama, Kaminari and teasing peers, or a learner in a chosen music project, in the relation the partner table gives.
setting_constraints: School, festival or chosen music project, field team operation, or adult community or professional context
Quirk embodiment, injury and knowledge limits respected
No adult private, romantic or family-conflict setting

scenario_readiness.note: The model's stated hypothetical (an adult community event seeking her musical help: technical leadership medium-high with a chosen purpose and practical role, deflection under an unwanted personal performance demand, protective action if friends are acutely threatened) and the probe's narrowly supported courage under asymmetry support narrow novel scenes. The probe is retrospective, nonblind and partial on motive.

conditions: The setting is a chosen music or teaching project with classmates, family or a learner, with the state named; recognition is offered by returning the decision to her and giving the skill a concrete use.
Output distinguishes technical leadership in a chosen role from deflection or embarrassment under unwanted personal exposure, and does not make every line sarcastic or teasing.
Private adult relationships, romance and unsampled leisure routines are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: The festival project is enacted and located (JK02-JK03); adult music and Eri instruction are author-comment and bonus-fiction claims that constrain rather than demonstrate, and the model marks private adult relationship variability OPEN.

Only a located moral stance exists: concrete friends over rank, rejecting All For One's disposable-extra classification (JK05). No choice weighing competing goods is located, so a novel dilemma's resolution would be invention.

The evidence set establishes neither romantic conduct nor its absence; JK06 shows her rejecting others' inference of romance from neighboring offices, and the model says romantic interiority remains unestablished. That limits inference; it says nothing about the character.

conditions: The setting is a student exam, team exercise or field operation in which she takes a specialized sensory or acoustic role, with the state named.
Output preserves fear alongside action, reliance on partners' distinct capacities, and the hearing channel's vulnerability and repaired-ear limit.
Independent adult agency work, career decisions and adult casework are not predicted.
scenario_readiness.note: Student field roles are located in the V02 coordination, the V08 exam (JK01), the V22 acoustic-locator team role (JK04) and the V36 final-war contribution (JK05); the adult professional state is one page (JK06) with supplement facts.

known_limits.statement: Courage under asymmetry coexists with genuine fear; the model REJECTs fearlessness, and fear in JK05 enlarges empathy rather than producing retreat.
Her sound's effect on All For One depended on his damaged, unstable factor system and allied follow-through, not on raw output exceeding his (JK05, JK-SUP-03).
Her repaired left ear is explicitly not back to its original state; full functional recovery must not be projected into later action (JK-SUP-03).
Neighboring offices with Kaminari are author-confirmed but do not establish romance; she rejects that inference herself (JK06, directly checked).
Her parents support her chosen hero path while sharing music; a rebellion against a forced career must not be invented (JK03).
Her decision policy finds a useful role and enables others' capacities rather than pursuing maximum visibility (JK01, JK04).
She learns the intensity of friends' fear in JK05 rather than having always understood it, and cannot infer an ally's full motives from one memory or the truth of outsiders' romantic speculation.

Supplement profile facts, editorial summaries, the author's statement that she apparently teaches Eri and bonus fiction (JK-SUP-01 to JK-SUP-03) constrain reconstruction without becoming enacted manga observations.

The single formal probe JK-V01 is a retrospective chronological evidence holdout by an analyst who had read later manga, not a blind experiment; action was supported only narrowly and motive was partial.
Private adult relationships, independent adult life and precise medical limits are OPEN in the model.
No atom covers V01, V03-V07, V09-V18, V21, V23-V35 or V37-V41, so behavior over those intervals is not established by this evidence set.

The deep readings, readiness index, supplemental reconciliation ledger and audit linked from the model are not curated evidence on this subject, so their warrants were not independently rechecked here. Anime performance and any supplement material beyond what the model cites lie outside this evidence set. Missing support is not evidence of absence.
